horoscopes.horoscope: You may cause some heart-breaks today, so be careful! Apart from this, Ganesha says, your love life is stable and you are ready to make a commitment to your loved one. If you are married, your relationship will become more intense and attachment will strengthen. A tension-free time with your sweetheart is on the cards. Try to be sweet and naughty with your partner. Seduce, caress and tease your partner in order to explore the fantasies. Make the most of this wonderful evening. Your day will begin with lots of energy and enthusiasm. However, in the scond half, you will get more practical in your thinking. You will not waste your energy then. Health will favour you which will help you perform tasks in a better manner. Second half of the day is going to make you feel more secure and stable regarding money matters, as compared to the first half, indicates Ganesha. You must not ignore any opportunity. You will be logically right today, but incessant brooding without a conclusion in sight might not prove very useful. Don’t hanker after unrealistic goals and waste your energy in their pursuit, advises Ganesha.

This is a day for going on a shopping spree, says Ganesha. There are strong chances that you will be buying something durable and lasting, may be the latest fridge on the stalls. Later in the day, you are most likely to visit an exhibition and pick up some artistic and exotic objects. You will be strongly motivated to get as many things as possible to make your home look classier and brighter. As the evening falls, you will fall asleep on the arm of your loved one. Love will beckon you this evening and you may head straight for that pleasant rendezvous with your sweetheart. Luckily you will win everything from your partner- admire, respect, support and love. You will find a difference as you proceed from the first half of the day to second half. You will perform tasks more vigorously in the second half. Your power to convince others will be stronger in the second half. This is a good day/time to mint money by selling your talents. You will be able to think more creatively about money matters. You will be able to encash opportunities coming your way. A pleasantly uneventful day for you. Plans will proceed according to your expectation and you will easily achieve your targets. Important tasks or meetings will get approved by higher authorities. You will turn quite lazy after the day’s hard work.

There seems to be a mood of celebration in your family. However, you will be busy handling a business deal while your family enjoys the occasion. You are likely to go on a tour for business purposes later in the day. You will devote time to achieving professional success rather than celebrating a personal achievement, says Ganesha. On the love front, things will be very smooth today. You can please your lover, have fun or enjoy togetherness at a friend’s home. Spend maximum time with your loved one, suggests Ganesha. You shall remain in an upbeat mood till afternoon. Hence, make best use of your energy reserves to manage challenging tasks. But, don’t get disappointed, as success may take some time to come your way. Adopt a balanced approach towards everything. Early in the day today, things will be favourable for you on the financial front. Ganesha foresees some gains and positive changes in your overall financial situation. You will fetch benefits from your colleagues, suggests Ganesha. Cash in on collective efforts and co-operate with your colleagues. Be careful with your words. Ganesha further advises you to keep a check on your emotions and temper.

Today, you will put your long-standing plan of buying a new house into action, or refurbishing the current house. You will have enough liquidity to be able to meet these expenses, and still be able to spare a substantial amount of money for investment in a business. Reign in your temper so that the harmony in your love relationship is not hampered. Check yourself if you go confrontational with your lover. Do yoga, meditation to maintain a better relationship, suggests Ganesha. You will see lot of action from your side in the first half of the day. You will be able to complete many difficult tasks. However, you should not take up many initiatives in the first half, as then you may lose a lot of energy. Chances of financial recovery are high in the second half of the day. While this seems to be a good day for money matters, you shouldn’t have very high hopes from those who are close to you. Play hard, work harder- this is the rule of the day. You will sweat a lot. You will have a hectic schedule at the workplace, with most of your time spent in solving queries and problems.

You will take some important decisions regarding personal or professional matters today, says Ganesha. The later half of the day will be spent enjoying with your family and friends. An extremely progressive day awaits. You will be in a good mood to express your love. You will be able to impress your sweetheart by being an absolute charmer. Your frank, free and benevolent attitude will melt the heart of your loved one. As you get ready for this fabulous day, your mind will be overflowing with positive thoughts. Consequently, you will manage to finish all your tasks with minimum efforts. In the evening, refrain from debating and don’t indulge in fruitless activities. In money matters you shall be lucky today, feels Ganesha. You may check out your luck in anything that appears lucrative, and you will be able to mint a substantial chunk of money. It’s a lucky day for you, and Ganesha wants you to make optimum use of this time. The braggart in you will come to the front today. Be careful while talking with your boss, colleagues or clients.

Heart-break kid – this is the new epithet for you today. Your pockets will empty faster than you can save. Expect marital bliss to blossom and bloom. Bond with the best, rather, your better half, advises Ganesha. Say sorry to your partner if you have committed even a small mistake. Else there will be a problem. Be extra-sensitive and caring towards your spouse and family members. You will be fortunate to receive supports and cooperation from your family members. This less favourable day may start on the wrong side of the bed. You shall have to meet the time-limits of your tasks – but don’t rush – because haste is waste. Instead, remain composed and things will fall in place by evening. It is likely that in the beginning of the day, you may feel some financial pressure. You will be concerned about the future. You may review your budget and try to rework things more favourably. Work is worship! Ganesha wants you to understand this very well today as you may waste a lot of time in office. You will have a lot of pending tasks to finish. You may feel stressed at the end of the day. So, take care of your health.

Ganesha says today will be a lucky day for you. You will make all efforts possible to please the person you love. You will pay special attention to your appearance and try to change your personality and attitude. There are chances of new romantic relationships developing for those looking for love. Your feelings may not reach the heart of your lover, but you can share your feelings with friends who support you, everywhere! Perhaps you can find your true future partner out of them. You will socialize and feel good in the first half of the day. You will be noticed and appreciated by others, which will increase your happiness. However, in second part of the day you may feel disappointed. But you should stay positive even then. You are not likely to remain unlucky about money matters, so be at peace and just keep working harder. Only thing that might worry you during the second half is ‘financial imbalance’. You cannot expect every day turns out to be positive. Today’s miss can be a tomorrow’s bliss- encourages Ganesha. Don’t let your mood swings affect your performance or conduct towards others. Be positive if you like to have positive events in the coming days.

Haste makes waste. It’s important to think twice before you come to a decision, says Ganesha, or your plans may go haywire. The day does not seem promising as your efforts may go in vain. Business trip on the cards. Make your beloved feel special, in the evening!. Since romance is in the air, it will make your relationship more passionate, says Ganesha. Don’t stop till you get enough. Though the day will be hectic, and your schedule would be tight, you shall easily and confidently handle everything. But, the situation may change during the latter half and you are likely to get puzzled while handling myriad tasks. You need to change your daily routine in a manner that your time is managed more efficiently. Avoid social networking and focus your time on money generating activities. The dexterity with which you handle meetings will help you win laurels at the workplace today. Opportunities to hobnob will make the social front a success. You will enjoy a sound professional relationship.

You may turn to your family for love and happiness today, predicts Ganesha. But your soul searching will come at a high material cost. In the evening, you may encounter a thrilling love prospect with who you might indulge in some adventurous activity. It might be the beginning of a platonic love affair, says Ganesha. You will be at your adventurous best this evening. An intimate evening with your beloved is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. Exploring different facets of love games at a jacuzzi will definitely turn on the moods of your sweetheart. You may go overboard and work very hard, as you shall feel very energetic today. But, after lunch time your mood may swing downwards and you will get exhausted. To rejuvenate – spend the evening in company of loved ones. Ganesha advises you to be positive that things are gong to work out in your favour on the financial front in the days ahead. In the second half of the day you will be less aggressive in spending money. With things going on at a smooth pace, you will enjoy this satisfying day. You will win your boss’ appreciation by performing your tasks with efficiency.

Work pressure may take a toll on you today, but you will overcome all impediments and excel in whatever work you undertake, says Ganesha. Support and motivation await you at home as family members will be exceedingly tolerant of your actions and endeavours. With the idea of a satisfying love relationship, you will spend an intimate evening with your sweetheart. You both will feel relaxed in each other’s company and may like to start something new and fresh in life. A boring day is on the cards for you. For a change, go on a small leisurely trip in order to resume the flow of creative juices from your mind. In the second half of the day, check your anger. Ganesha feels that if you want your finances to stabilize or grow, you must become proactive about earning more money. You should be able to stay focused on financial matters all through the day. Technical glitches may get on your nerves. Put your logical abilities to use to solve all occupational problems, suggests Ganesha. You will be professionally inclined towards technical matters. Even you may turn a techno entrepreneur to inspire the team at the boardroom.

Action is your forte, so seize the initiative and you will come out a winner! The afternoon sees you happy, but heavy-duty work may take a toll on you. Relax a bit — listen to music, play with your pet, or simply don your best attire and step out to socialise!. Singles will hang out with new friends at hyper malls or shopping destinations. Couples will desire to spend some intimate moments with your darling. Traveling to some exciting places with your loved one will rekindle the romance with your sweetheart. Today your creativity will come to the fore – which shall help you to easily tackle challenging tasks. Set your priorities and divert your energies in the right direction – to clear all the work backlog and enjoy this excellent day. Today, you shall be preoccupied about other people’s progress, especially your own folks. Though it is a good thing to observe others, Ganesha advises you to also seek lessons from it. Today is not the right time to launch a new and bold venture as there are chances that the projects you start today may get delayed or may not bring good results. Spend the day interacting with trusted seniors or expert angel investors from your professional associations.

A progressive day when it comes to matter related to the workplace, says Ganesha. Projects that you have slaved over for long, will finally come to fruition today. You will be able to reap the benefits of your hard labour now. You will take up new and interesting projects now. Minor financial expenses could be the bump in the road for you today. On the romantic front, avoid getting angry with your partner; choose your words carefully. Do yoga and meditation daily, suggests Ganesha. Simply remain focussed on fruitful activities – it will provide a sense of satisfaction and also keep you happy. As the days descends, your heart will try to rule over your heart. Stay balanced and be pragmatic to maintain good health. Ganesha advises you to choose the first half of the day for financial negotiations, as lady luck will not be very much in your favour in the second half of the day. Unfortunately, it may not be a great day today. Any materialistic issues like financial problems, house issues or gadget related difficulties will grab your attention but at the same time, you may remain attentive to your work.
